# ANALYSIS: BASELINE_ENGINE_EDGE_CAPTURE_MEASUREMENT

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need to establish the ground-truth edge_capture and OOS performance of the current baseline engine (no changes) on J's source-of-truth anchor days. This baseline is essential for evaluating all future candidates per OP-16, as edge_capture must exceed 771 to avoid rejection. The leaderboard shows STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND reports baseline edge_capture=780 (unchanged), but we require direct measurement via Stage-1 backtest to confirm.

## Mechanism

Run the Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder harness on the current engine configuration (params.json as-of today) without any modifications. Measure:
- Engine P&L on each of the 6 J anchor days (3 winners, 3 losers)
- Aggregate edge_capture = sum(winner P&L) - sum(max(0, loser P&L))
- Walk-forward OOS performance (Sharpe, win rate, expectancy) over the full available history
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days using cached OPRA data (simulator_real.py)

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Baseline engine uses current params.json position sizing. For Safe account ($2K), min 3 contracts; requires $25K+ for full headline qty (15 contracts). $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L per OP-20 disclosure example.
2. **Sample bias:** J anchor days are fixed source-of-truth (6 days: 3 winners, 3 losers). Selection method: J's live trades. Overfit risk: low for anchor days as they are not used in optimization; high risk if engine tuned to these days only (mitigated by OOS/walk-forward requirements).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be completed as part of Stage-1 backtest)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days validation to be completed as part of Stage-1 backtest)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: max single-day loss in backtest (likely 5/06 or 5/07 loser)
   - Max drawdown: peak-to-trough equity curve decline
   - Blow-up scenario: consecutive losses triggering daily loss kill switch (−30% Safe/−50% Bold) combined with position sizing errors
6. **Concentration:** Will report top-5 days P&L as % of total P&L from backtest. If >100%, indicates extreme concentration (e.g., one day >100% of P&L).

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: all tests pass (backtest/autoresearch/*_grinder.py)
- Walk-forward: OOS Sharpe > 0, WF ratio ≥ 0.70, sub-window stability (no sign-flips in quarters)
- Real-fills: top 3 J days BS-sim vs real OPRA diff < ±20% (per L12/L23)
- Anchor no-regression: edge_capture on J days must be ≥ 0 (we expect positive on winners, negative on losers)
- A/B scorecard filed: analysis/recommendations/baseline_engine_edge_capture.json

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- We are proposing to run the backtest, but results are unknown until execution. Confidence based on historical baseline performance (STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND reports 780 edge_capture).

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This analysis establishes the baseline for all candidates in _LEADERBOARD.md. It does not conflict with any candidate; rather, it provides the reference point against which candidate edge_capture deltas are measured. All candidates currently list projected edge_capture relative to this baseline (e.g., STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND shows delta=0). If our measurement differs from 780, all projected values in the leaderboard require rebasing.
